headline: IBEX 35 Breaks 18,000 Mark for the First Time Despite Global Market Jitters
summary: The Madrid-based IBEX 35 closed above the 18,000-point threshold for the first time in its history on Monday, defying falling commodity prices that weighed on investor sentiment.
why: The IBEX 35 is Spain's benchmark stock index, tracking the country's largest listed companies across banking, utilities and energy.

impacts.name: IBEX 35
impacts.why: The benchmark index reached a record closing level above 18,000 points.
